bio.text: Charles Burkett is a candidate with no party affiliation for governor of Florida in the November 3, 2026 general election.
WLRN describes him as a former four-term mayor of Surfside and reported that, as mayor in 2021, he navigated the community through the Champlain Towers South condominium collapse.

sources.title: Former Surfside mayor Charles Burkett enters Florida Governors' race
